title: 'One of the most thought-provoking books I've read on building organizations designed to endure'
summary: Ron Scheese — a Goodreads reviewer with 296 reviews focused on evergreen and triple-bottom-line business — connects Incorruptible to his own interest in cross-generational company-building. Notes the book was recommended by a friend who has led a triple-bottom-line company for over 40 years.
blockquote: I just finished Eric Ries' latest book "Incorruptible," one of the most thought-provoking books I've read on building organizations designed to endure.
